source_geometry_limitations.method: Blender source-UV thin meshes with semantic material masks and keyed authored deformation. Support buckling precedes connected cloth folding; source-visible rims and sides detach separately. No filled hull or voxel partition. Every raw frame rendered in Blender.
source_geometry_limitations.limitation: Each camera has a separately source-mapped Blender mesh collection, not a shared 3D model or simulation. Hidden faces cannot be recovered. C3 rear-wheel hidden rim is explicitly inferred and revealed as the barrel moves away. B23 S/W has an explicitly inferred dark source-painted bottom behind the falling lid; it is not recovered original geometry. Cloth folds and cage buckling are authored shape keys. Source shadows are retained. No physical-validity or release-approval claim.
source_geometry_limitations.blender_inspection: not opened; no geometry dimensions claimed from Blender; source metadata explicitly describes directional painted surfaces rather than certified native collision
